description: This file defines custom frame types for OpenAI Realtime API integration within the Pipecat project. It introduces data classes for context update frames and function call result frames used specifically in the realtime OpenAI service, including deprecation notices and relevant parameters.

classes.name: RealtimeMessagesUpdateFrame
classes.description: Frame indicating that the realtime context messages have been updated, containing a reference to the OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext.

classes.name: RealtimeFunctionCallResultFrame
classes.description: Frame containing function call results for the realtime service, encapsulating a FunctionCallResultFrame.
